title: DNA Extraction from FANS sorted nuclei
author: Stefania S Policicchio
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bmpmk5k6

steps.title: Defrost nuclei on ice
steps.instruction: Place frozen FANS‑sorted nuclei tubes (1.5 mL) on ice until thawed. Aliquot 1–2 samples (~200 000 nuclei per tube) to obtain 300–500 ng DNA per population.

steps.title: Add Slagboom buffer
steps.instruction: Add Slagboom buffer (SB) to each tube: 250 µL for ~200 000 nuclei (or up to 1 × 10⁶ cells), 500 µL for larger pellets, or 1 mL for very large pellets. If nuclei are stored in running buffer, supplement with 10× STE and 5 % SDS to reach the same final composition (1× STE, 0.5 % SDS). Example: for a 400 µL sample add 50 µL 10× STE and 50 µL 5 % SDS to make 500 µL total.

steps.title: Add RNase A
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL RNase A per 500 µL of buffer in each tube.

steps.title: Incubate at 37 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate tubes in a heat block at 37 °C for 45 minutes.

steps.title: Add proteinase K
steps.instruction: Add proteinase K to a final concentration of 2 mg mL⁻¹ (e.g., 5 µL per 500 µL SB).

steps.title: Mix by inversion
steps.instruction: Invert the tubes gently 10 times; do not vortex or pipette‑mix.

steps.title: Incubate at 60 °C
steps.instruction: Place tubes in a water bath at 60 °C for 1 hour.

steps.title: Cool to room temperature
steps.instruction: Remove tubes from the water bath and let stand at room temperature for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Add Majiik Mix
steps.instruction: For every 500 µL SB used, add 100 µL Majiik Mix (e.g., 200 µL for 1 mL SB). Mix by vigorous inversion; do not vortex.

steps.title: First centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 17 000 × g, room temperature, 10 minutes.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant (first)
steps.instruction: Carefully pipette the supernatant into a new labelled 1.5 mL tube, leaving ~50 µL behind.

steps.title: Second Majiik Mix addition
steps.instruction: Add another 100 µL Majiik Mix to the tube containing the remaining ~50 µL, mix by vigorous inversion, then centrifuge again at 17 000 × g, room temperature, 10 minutes.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant (second)
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a new labelled 1.5 mL tube, leaving ~50 µL in the previous tube. If the volume exceeds 1 mL, split into two tubes.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with isopropanol
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of 100 % isopropanol to each tube (e.g., 1 mL isopropanol to 1 mL supernatant). Optionally add 0.7–1 µL Glycogen Blue per tube to aid pellet visualization.

steps.title: Mix and precipitate
steps.instruction: Invert the tubes 10 times to mix.

steps.title: Pellet DNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 17 000 × g, room temperature, 15 minutes with tube hinges upward.

steps.title: Remove isopropanol
steps.instruction: Carefully discard the supernatant without disturbing the weakly adherent DNA pellet.

steps.title: Wash pellet with ethanol
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL 80 % ethanol to each tube, mix gently by pipetting.

steps.title: Ethanol wash centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 17 000 × g, room temperature, 5 minutes.

steps.title: Remove residual ethanol
steps.instruction: Pulse‑centrifuge to collect remaining liquid at the tube bottom, then discard the residual liquid without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Air‑dry pellet
steps.instruction: Air‑dry the DNA pellet with tube lids open for 5–15 minutes. Optional: dry an additional 10 minutes at 37 °C, avoiding over‑drying.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 20 µL ddH₂O or 1× TE (use 15 µL if yield is expected to be very low). Gently flick the tube; avoid pipette mixing.

steps.title: Pulse spin to collect solution
steps.instruction: Pulse‑spin the tube briefly to bring liquid to the bottom and help dislodge the pellet from the tube wall.

steps.title: Overnight equilibration
steps.instruction: Store tubes at 4 °C overnight to allow complete resuspension before quantifying DNA (Nanodrop or Qubit).
